comments.body:
iubenda – Cookie and Consent Solution for the GDPR & ePrivacy Plugin https://wordpress.org/plugins/iubenda-cookie-law-solution/ already added their cookie solution for ampforwp plugin too.
Settings screenshot: https://ibb.co/ccV17QG

And if you are getting any trouble while integrating it you can through this guide https://www.iubenda.com/en/help/3182-cookie-consent-amp-pages
